author: Engel, 1927

note.en: A glass-clear sap-sucking slug with leaf-like body flaps, known here from five museum specimens at Punta Piuta, Punta Uva and Manzanillo.
note.es: Una babosa chupadora de savia transparente con solapas como hojas, conocida aquí por cinco ejemplares de museo de Punta Piuta, Punta Uva y Manzanillo.

evidence: GBIF: 5 museum specimens, 4 to 25 m, 1999 to 2003

sources.t: GBIF: preserved specimens, Universidad de Costa Rica collection (Calderón, Avila and others, 1998 to 2003)
WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and classification
